summary.text: Rusty Grills is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 77 who has served since January 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Rusty Grills succeeded Casey Hood in Tennessee House District 77 and assumed office on January 14, 2020.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Agriculture and Natural Resources, Civil Justice and Transportation committees and the House Rules Committee.
